issues: The script contains a critical error: it uses the SLURM launcher `srun` to execute the application. When run under Flux, this command will fail. It must be replaced with the native Flux launcher, `flux run`.

As correctly noted in the script's comments, the script is missing an explicit memory request. For a large MPI job running on 96 tasks, this is a catastrophic omission. The job will receive a small, default memory allocation and is almost certain to fail with an out-of-memory error.

The use of a shell glob (`*.inp`) as an input argument to a parallel `cp2k.popt` command is highly suspect. This will expand on the submission node, and either all 96 ranks will receive the same single input file, or the command will receive a list of multiple input files, both of which are likely not the intended parallel execution pattern.
The script is non-portable as it sources a module environment script from a hardcoded absolute path (`/ssoft/spack/bin/slmodules.sh`).
